# Components

Every component you can place in a window, in the order of the **Components** palette of Design. *Events* are what can start a flow; *Read* and *Change* list what blocks and `ctx` accept for each kind, checked against the code when this page is built.

## Separator

A thin line between groups of components.

| | |
|---|---|
| **Events** | — |
| **Read** | — |
| **Change** | `ctx.set_enabled` |

## Spacer

Empty space that pushes the next components to the end of a row or column.

| | |
|---|---|
| **Events** | — |
| **Read** | — |
| **Change** | `ctx.set_enabled` |

## Window

A window of the app. Holds the other components and sets the title, size, frame, menus, timer, full screen and window look (theme, accent, background color and image).

| | |
|---|---|
| **Events** | *start* (when the window opens), *close* (when the window is about to close), *timer* (every few seconds (Timer on the window)), *menu* (when a menu item is chosen) |
| **Read** | — |
| **Change** | — |

## Container

Groups components as a column, row, grid or free positioning, with spacing and margins.

| | |
|---|---|
| **Events** | — |
| **Read** | — |
| **Change** | `ctx.set_enabled` |

## Tabbed pages

Tabbed pages. Holds only pages; choose which one opens first in Initial page.

| | |
|---|---|
| **Events** | — |
| **Read** | — |
| **Change** | `ctx.set_enabled` |

## Page

One page of Tabbed pages, with its own title and components.

| | |
|---|---|
| **Events** | — |
| **Read** | — |
| **Change** | `ctx.set_enabled`, `ctx.show_page` |

## Image

Shows a picture copied into the project's assets folder, with an accessible description.

| | |
|---|---|
| **Events** | — |
| **Read** | — |
| **Change** | `ctx.set_enabled` |

## Text

A line or paragraph of text.

| | |
|---|---|
| **Events** | — |
| **Read** | `"text"` (text) |
| **Change** | `ctx.set_text`, `ctx.set_enabled` |

## Button

A button with text, an optional icon and a tooltip. Clicking it fires click.

| | |
|---|---|
| **Events** | *click* (when the button is clicked) |
| **Read** | `"text"` (text) |
| **Change** | `ctx.set_text`, `ctx.set_enabled` |

## Text field

A one-line field for typing, with a hint shown while it is empty.

| | |
|---|---|
| **Events** | *change* (when the person changes the value) |
| **Read** | `"text"` (text) |
| **Change** | `ctx.set_text`, `ctx.set_enabled` |

## Checkbox

An option that is on or off, with its text.

| | |
|---|---|
| **Events** | *change* (when the person changes the value) |
| **Read** | `"text"` (text), `"checked"` (checked (yes/no)) |
| **Change** | `ctx.set_text`, `ctx.set_enabled` |

## Progress

A progress bar from 0 to 100.

| | |
|---|---|
| **Events** | — |
| **Read** | `"value"` (value (number)) |
| **Change** | `ctx.set_enabled`, `ctx.set_value` |

## Long text

A box for several lines of text.

| | |
|---|---|
| **Events** | *change* (when the person changes the value) |
| **Read** | `"text"` (text) |
| **Change** | `ctx.set_text`, `ctx.set_enabled` |

## Choice list

A drop-down list: options typed one per line, or records shown with show records.

| | |
|---|---|
| **Events** | *change* (when the person changes the value) |
| **Read** | `"text"` (text), `"record"` (selected record id) |
| **Change** | `ctx.set_text`, `ctx.set_enabled`, `ctx.set_options`, `ctx.show_records` |

## Date

A date picker. Its text is the date as YYYY-MM-DD.

| | |
|---|---|
| **Events** | *change* (when the person changes the value) |
| **Read** | `"text"` (text) |
| **Change** | `ctx.set_text`, `ctx.set_enabled` |

## Table

Rows and columns, with the column names you type. Fill it with rows or with records; large tables stay fast because only visible cells are drawn.

| | |
|---|---|
| **Events** | *change* (when the person changes the value) |
| **Read** | `"selected"` (selected row (list of cells)), `"record"` (selected record id) |
| **Change** | `ctx.set_enabled`, `ctx.set_rows`, `ctx.add_row`, `ctx.show_records`, `ctx.export_table_csv` |

## Chart

A bar, line or pie chart that shows labels and numbers.

| | |
|---|---|
| **Events** | — |
| **Read** | — |
| **Change** | `ctx.set_enabled`, `ctx.set_chart` |

## Number

A number field with minimum, maximum, step and decimals.

| | |
|---|---|
| **Events** | *change* (when the person changes the value) |
| **Read** | `"value"` (value (number)) |
| **Change** | `ctx.set_enabled`, `ctx.set_value` |

## Slider

A slider between a minimum and a maximum, with a step.

| | |
|---|---|
| **Events** | *change* (when the person changes the value) |
| **Read** | `"value"` (value (number)) |
| **Change** | `ctx.set_enabled`, `ctx.set_value` |

## Output panel

A read-only panel that shows the output of tasks and of write to output.

| | |
|---|---|
| **Events** | — |
| **Read** | `"text"` (text) |
| **Change** | `ctx.set_text`, `ctx.set_enabled` |

## Terminal

An interactive terminal. Runs a program (or the shell) when started by blocks, or when the app starts if Start when the application runs is on.

| | |
|---|---|
| **Events** | — |
| **Read** | — |
| **Change** | `ctx.set_enabled`, `ctx.terminal_start` |
